card.name: Dosing frequency wording
card.fires_on: The unit of time or count in a dosing interval, such as 'hours' after 'every 2' or 'times' after 'three'. It also fires on 'batteries' in a safety checklist.

modes.label: Dose interval words
modes.description: The word completing how often a drug is applied, such as hours, times, hourly or apart.
modes.example: instill one drop in the affected eye(s) every three<< hours>> (maximum of 6 doses per day

modes.label: Eye-drop instructions
modes.description: The closing bracket or phrase in an instruction to instill drops in the eye.
modes.example: Day 1: Instill one drop every two hours in the affected eye(s<<)>> while awake, up to 8 times

modes.label: Change batteries checklist
modes.description: The word 'batteries' or 'the' in a home-safety tip about changing smoke detector batteries.
modes.example: Check and change the<< batteries>> regularly.
